Name: Custom Drop Rates
Author: Seshnik
Description:
[center][b][size=5][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_DESC_Banner.png[/img][/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Customize your drop rates![/i][/center]


Ever run out of wood before finishing your farm? Tired of the mine grind? [b]Custom Drop Rates [/b]lets you multiply how many resources drop from almost anything in the game, such as Mining, Woodcutting, Foraging, Monsters, Machines, etc... Set your own pace and play the way you want.

Supports [b]GMCM[/b] for full in-game configuration, or manually edit the config.json file if you don't want to use GMCM.


[center][heading][b][size=5][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Banner_V2.png[/img][/size]
[/b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]V2.0 is a major update, jumping from V1.4.0, adding a whole suite of new things![/size][/color][/heading]
[/center]
[list]
[*][b]Machines: [/b] Keg, Preserves Jar, Cheese Press, Mayonnaise Machine, Bee House, Loom, Oil Maker, Furnace, Seed Maker, Mushroom Log & Mushroom Cave.[/*]
[*][b]Monster Drops:[/b] Multiply loot from all mobs![/*]
[*][b]Foraging: [/b]More wild forage per pickup, with optional quality modifiers.[/*]
[*][b]Fruit Trees:[/b] Extra fruit per shake, with optional quality modifiers.[/*]
[*][b]Tappers: [/b]More tapper product per collection.[/*]
[*][b]Mushrooms:[/b] More mushrooms from mushroom trees, Mushroom Log & Mushroom Box (Farm Cave), with optional quality modifiers.[/*]
[*][b]Moss: [/b]Extra moss from mossy trees, green rain bushes, and weeds[/*]
[*][b]Fiber / Hay:[/b] More fiber from weeds, more hay from scything grass[/*]
[*][b]Artifact Spots:[/b] more items from digging wiggly worm spots[/*]
[/list]
[center][heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Feature_list.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[/center]
[center][i]Current feature list.[/i][/center]

[heading][left][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Mining.png[/img][/b][/left]
[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stone (Rocks & Boulders)[/*]
[*]Coal[/*]
[*]Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, Radioactive Ores[/*]
[*]Cinder Shards[/*]
[*]Clay (Rocks & Artifact Spots)[/*]
[*]Minerals (Diamond, Ruby, Jade, Amethyst, Topaz, Emerald, Aquamarine)[/*]
[*]Geodes (Normal, Frozen, Magma, Omni)[/*]
[*]Calico Eggs (Desert Festival)[/*]
[*]Bone Fragments[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_TreesPlants.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Wood (All tree types including Ginger Island palms & Green rain trees)[/*]
[*]Hardwood (Mahogany trees & stumps, large clumps)[/*]
[*]Fruit Trees (Quantity multiplier for Fruit drops + Quality modifiers)[/*]
[*]Mushroom Trees (Shake & Cutting Drops + Quality modifiers)[/*]
[*]Tappers  (More output per collection)[/*]
[*]Moss  (From mossy trees, green rain bushes, weeds)[/*]
[*]Fiber  (From weeds)[/*]
[*]Hay  (From scything grass, requires Silo on the Farm!)[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Mushrooms.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Mushroom Log[/*]
[*]Mushroom Box (Farm Cave)[/*]
[*]Mushroom Tree (Shaking & Cutting them down)[/*]
[*]Optional Quality Modifier (Default / Normal / Silver / Gold / Iridium)[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Foraging.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]All wild forage (Quantity multiplier + Optional quality modifier)[/*]
[*]Artifact Spots (wiggly worm spots) (Quantity multiplier on the item you dig up)[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_MonsterDrops.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]All monster drops[/*]
[*]Ore drops (Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, Radioactive) use their respective Ore multiplier you set for them elsewhere.[/*]
[*]Bone Fragments have their own separate multiplier.[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Machines.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Keg: Quantity multiplier + Optional quality modifier.[/*]
[*]Preserves Jar: Quantity multiplier + Optional quality modifier.[/*]
[*]Cheese Press: Quantity multiplier + Optional quality modifier.[/*]
[*]Mayonnaise Machine: Quantity multiplier + Optional quality modifier.[/*]
[*]Bee House: Quantity multiplier[/*]
[*]Loom: Quantity multiplier[/*]
[*]Oil Maker: Quantity multiplier[/*]
[*]Furnace: Quantity multiplier[/*]
[*]Seed Maker: Quantity multiplier[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_fish-ponds.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Pond output quantity multiplier[/*]
[*]Roe quantity multiplier (Separate from other pond items)[/*]
[*]Force daily produce (Guaranteed to produce something every day)[/*]
[*]Force Roe only (Only produce Roe)[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_install-instructions.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (required)[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (recommended)[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game and configure everything from the GMCM settings menu[/*]
[/list]All multipliers default to [b]1.0[/b] (vanilla) on first install. You won't notice any change until you adjust them.

You can also edit [b]config.json[/b] directly in the mod's folder if you prefer, there is now a [b]config-guide.txt [/b]file included which explains each setting inside the config.json file.

[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Multiplayer.png[/img][/b][/heading]
When playing co-op, the [b]host's settings automatically sync to all other players[/b] when they join. Players see the settings in GMCM but cannot change them, only the host can. All players need the mod installed for it to work correctly.
[list]
[*][i]Multiplayer Support has not been tested, though I believe it should work.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Compatibility.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#00cc00]✔[/color] Works with [b]GMCM[/b] for in-game configuration[/*]
[*][color=#00cc00]✔[/color] Supports Stardew Valley version 1.6.[/*]
[*][color=#ff4444]✖[/color] May conflict with mods that completely overhaul drop mechanics[/*]
[*][color=#ff4444]✖[/color] May not work correctly with mods that add new custom resource nodes[/*]
[*][color=#ff4444]✖[/color] Will not work on game versions below 1.6[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_Limitations.png[/img][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Drop rates can only be increased, not decreased below vanilla (minimum is 1.0x). Reducing drops is not possible.[/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Seshnik/CDR_Nexus_Images/main/CDR_bugs-requests.png[/img][/b][/heading]
Please report any bugs you find comments or in the dedicated bug reports area and I'll look into it.
Bug reports are very helpful, please include your SMAPI log if possible!

If you'd like a resource or machine added, let me know in the comments and I may add it in a future update!
